--!strict
-- UiStyle: chunky homepage-sim buttons and panels built from plain instances.
-- See wiki/ui/Sim Button Anatomy.md for the layer breakdown.
-- Button layers (back to front): Lip (dark bevel + outline) > Face (fill) > Studs > Shade > Gloss > Dim > Icon > Label > Badge

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local UiStyle = {}

UiStyle.Colors = {
	Red = Color3.fromRGB(235, 45, 50),
	Pink = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 145),
	Orange = Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 25),
	Yellow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 40),
	Green = Color3.fromRGB(70, 205, 60),
	Blue = Color3.fromRGB(30, 170, 255),
	Purple = Color3.fromRGB(165, 65, 255),
	Gold = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 30),
	Dark = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50),
	Outline = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 32),
	White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
}

UiStyle.Font = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/FredokaOne.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold)

local OUTLINE = 3
local LIP = 5
local STUD = 12
local STUD_GAP = 6
local MAX_STUDS = 160

local RAINBOW = ColorSequence.new({
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 60)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.18, Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 60)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 30)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.36, Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 30)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.38, Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 40)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.52, Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 40)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.54, Color3.fromRGB(70, 215, 70)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.68, Color3.fromRGB(70, 215, 70)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 255)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.84, Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 255)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.86, Color3.fromRGB(170, 70, 255)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(170, 70, 255)),
})

local function darken(c: Color3, amount: number): Color3
	local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
	return Color3.fromHSV(h, math.min(1, s + amount * 0.2), v * (1 - amount))
end
UiStyle.Darken = darken

local function new(className: string, props: { [string]: any }, children: { Instance }?): any
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for k, v in props do
		if k ~= "Parent" then
			(inst :: any)[k] = v
		end
	end
	if children then
		for _, child in children do
			child.Parent = inst
		end
	end
	if props.Parent then
		inst.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return inst
end

local function corner(radius: number): UICorner
	return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) })
end

local function stroke(thickness: number, color: Color3?, transparency: number?): UIStroke
	return new("UIStroke", {
		Thickness = thickness,
		Color = color or UiStyle.Colors.Outline,
		Transparency = transparency or 0,
		LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round,
	})
end

-- Stud tile pattern: small rounded square outlines on a grid, refilled when the size changes
local function addStuds(parent: GuiObject, color: Color3, transparency: number, zIndex: number, inset: number): Frame
	local holder = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Studs",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(inset, inset),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset * 2, 1, -inset * 2),
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		ZIndex = zIndex,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	new("UIGridLayout", {
		CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(STUD, STUD),
		CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(STUD_GAP, STUD_GAP),
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
		VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		Parent = holder,
	})
	local count = 0
	local function fill()
		local size = holder.AbsoluteSize
		local cell = STUD + STUD_GAP
		local want = math.min(MAX_STUDS, math.ceil(size.X / cell) * math.ceil(size.Y / cell))
		while count < want do
			count += 1
			new("Frame", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				ZIndex = zIndex,
				Parent = holder,
			}, { corner(3), stroke(1.5, color, transparency) })
		end
	end
	holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fill)
	task.defer(fill)
	return holder
end

-- Chunky white text with a thick dark outline
function UiStyle.Label(props: { [string]: any }): TextLabel
	return new("TextLabel", {
		Name = props.Name or "Label",
		Text = props.Text or "",
		FontFace = UiStyle.Font,
		TextColor3 = props.TextColor3 or UiStyle.Colors.White,
		TextScaled = true,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.new(),
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.zero,
		TextXAlignment = props.TextXAlignment or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 1,
		Parent = props.Parent,
	}, {
		stroke(props.StrokeThickness or 3, props.StrokeColor),
		new("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = props.MaxTextSize or 48 }),
	})
end

local function makeIcon(icon: string, zIndex: number): GuiObject
	if icon:find("^rbxasset") or icon:find("^http") then
		return new("ImageLabel", {
			Name = "Icon",
			Image = icon,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
			ZIndex = zIndex,
		})
	end
	return new("TextLabel", {
		Name = "Icon",
		Text = icon,
		TextScaled = true,
		FontFace = UiStyle.Font,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ZIndex = zIndex,
	})
end

local function makeBadge(z: number): Frame
	local badge = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Badge",
		Visible = false,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 4),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
		BackgroundColor3 = UiStyle.Colors.Red,
		ZIndex = z,
	}, {
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
		stroke(3),
		new("UIGradient", {
			Rotation = 90,
			Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)),
		}),
	})
	UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "Text",
		Text = "!",
		StrokeThickness = 2,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		ZIndex = z + 1,
		Parent = badge,
	})
	return badge
end

-- Big chunky button. Stable children for other code: Label (TextLabel), Badge (Frame, hidden), Icon (when given)
function UiStyle.Button(props: { [string]: any }): TextButton
	local color: Color3 = props.Color or UiStyle.Colors.Blue
	local shape = props.Shape or "Wide"
	local z = props.ZIndex or 2
	local radius = props.CornerRadius or (if shape == "Square" then 12 else 8)

	local button = new("TextButton", {
		Name = props.Name or "Button",
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or (if shape == "Square" then UDim2.fromOffset(96, 96) else UDim2.fromOffset(200, 56)),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.new(),
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.zero,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		ZIndex = z,
	})
	local scale = new("UIScale", { Name = "Scale", Parent = button })

	-- Lip: darker copy of the fill under the face, carries the outer outline
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Lip",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = if props.Rainbow then Color3.fromRGB(90, 40, 140) else darken(color, 0.45),
		ZIndex = z,
		Parent = button,
	}, { corner(radius), stroke(OUTLINE) })

	local face = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Face",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -LIP),
		BackgroundColor3 = if props.Rainbow then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else color,
		ZIndex = z + 1,
		Parent = button,
	}, { corner(radius) })
	if props.Rainbow then
		new("UIGradient", { Color = RAINBOW, Rotation = -30, Parent = face })
	end

	if props.Studs ~= false then
		addStuds(face, darken(color, 0.5), 0.55, z + 2, math.floor(radius / 2))
	end

	-- Shade: bottom of the face gets darker
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Shade",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		ZIndex = z + 3,
		Parent = face,
	}, {
		corner(radius),
		new("UIGradient", {
			Rotation = 90,
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.72),
			}),
		}),
	})

	-- Gloss: soft white band on the top half
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Gloss",
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.45, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		ZIndex = z + 4,
		Parent = face,
	}, {
		corner(math.max(radius - 3, 2)),
		new("UIGradient", {
			Rotation = 90,
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.92),
			}),
		}),
	})

	local dim = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Dim",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ZIndex = z + 5,
		Parent = face,
	}, { corner(radius) })

	local label = UiStyle.Label({
		Text = props.Text or "",
		ZIndex = z + 7,
		MaxTextSize = props.MaxTextSize,
		StrokeThickness = props.StrokeThickness or 3,
	})

	if props.Icon ~= nil and props.Icon ~= "" then
		local icon = makeIcon(props.Icon, z + 6)
		if shape == "Square" then
			-- big icon fills the top and pokes past the edge like the reference
			icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, -0.08)
			icon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.78)
			label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -LIP - 2)
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.3)
		else
			-- icon hangs off the left edge, label fills the rest
			icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, -10, 0.5, -LIP / 2)
			icon.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeYY
			icon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.1, 1.1)
			label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			label.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, -LIP / 2)
			label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, -8, 0.72, 0)
		end
		icon.Parent = button
	else
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -LIP / 2)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.72, 0)
	end
	label.Parent = button

	local badge = makeBadge(z + 8)
	badge.Visible = props.Badge == true
	badge.Parent = button

	-- Hover / press feel: scale bump, face sinks into the lip, darkens
	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local hovering = false
	local function setState(state: string)
		local s = if state == "press" then 0.93 elseif state == "hover" then 1.06 else 1
		local d = if state == "press" then 0.75 elseif state == "hover" then 0.92 else 1
		local y = if state == "press" then LIP - 1 else 0
		TweenService:Create(scale, info, { Scale = s }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(dim, info, { BackgroundTransparency = d }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(face, info, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y) }):Play()
	end
	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		hovering = true
		setState("hover")
	end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		hovering = false
		setState("idle")
	end)
	button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		setState("press")
	end)
	button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		setState(if hovering then "hover" else "idle")
	end)

	if props.Parent then
		button.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return button
end

-- Popup panel: colored header bar with title, red X button (child "Close"), dark stud body (child "Body")
function UiStyle.Panel(props: { [string]: any }): Frame
	local color: Color3 = props.Color or UiStyle.Colors.Pink
	local z = props.ZIndex or 10
	local header = props.HeaderHeight or 56

	local panel = new("Frame", {
		Name = props.Name or "Panel",
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(520, 380),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		BackgroundColor3 = props.BodyColor or UiStyle.Colors.Dark,
		BackgroundTransparency = props.BodyTransparency or 0.08,
		ZIndex = z,
	}, { corner(16), stroke(4) })

	local shine = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200))
	local bar = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Header",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, header),
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		ZIndex = z + 1,
		Parent = panel,
	}, { corner(14), new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Color = shine }) })
	-- squares off the header's bottom corners
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Fill",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
		BackgroundColor3 = darken(color, 0.2),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = z + 1,
		Parent = bar,
	})
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Gloss",
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 4),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.4, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		ZIndex = z + 2,
		Parent = bar,
	}, {
		corner(10),
		new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.6, 0.95) }),
	})

	UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "Title",
		Text = props.Title or "",
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 4),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, -8),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		StrokeThickness = 4,
		MaxTextSize = 44,
		ZIndex = z + 3,
		Parent = bar,
	})

	UiStyle.Button({
		Name = "Close",
		Text = "X",
		Color = UiStyle.Colors.Red,
		Shape = "Square",
		Studs = false,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(header + 8, header + 8),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -header / 2 + 4, 0, header / 2 - 6),
		MaxTextSize = 44,
		StrokeThickness = 4,
		ZIndex = z + 4,
		Parent = panel,
	})

	local body = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Body",
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, header + 12),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -header - 24),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.6,
		ZIndex = z + 1,
		Parent = panel,
	}, { corner(12) })
	-- ZIndex 0 keeps the pattern under anything put in Body (HUD uses Sibling ZIndexBehavior)
	addStuds(body, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.9, 0, 6)

	if props.Parent then
		panel.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return panel
end

return UiStyle

-- Eggs. Odds are shown to players on the egg board and in the hatch UI
-- (required for any random item, and always for the Robux egg).
-- Chance values are percents and add up to 100 per egg.
local Eggs = {}

local STANDARD = {55, 28, 12, 4, 0.9, 0.1}

local function egg(name, world, cost, petIds)
	local pets = {}
	for i, id in petIds do
		table.insert(pets, {Id = id, Chance = STANDARD[i]})
	end
	return {Name = name, World = world, Cost = cost, Pets = pets}
end

Eggs.List = {
	Starter = egg("Starter Egg", 1, 25, {"Doggy", "Kitty", "Bunny", "Fox", "Unicorn", "DemiDog"}),
	Buff = egg("Buff Egg", 1, 250, {"Bear", "Gorilla", "Wolf", "Lion", "GoldenGorilla", "Cerberus"}),
	Candy = egg("Candy Egg", 2, 5000, {"GummyBear", "LollipopCat", "CupcakePup", "CandyDragon", "SugarDemon", "RainbowUnicorn"}),
	CandyPlus = egg("Candy+ Egg", 2, 40000, {"ChocoBunny", "MarshmallowSheep", "DonutDog", "CottonCandyFairy", "CandyKing", "CandyHydra"}),
	Frost = egg("Frost Egg", 3, 400000, {"Penguin", "SnowFox", "IceWolf", "Yeti", "FrostPhoenix", "IceHydra"}),
	FrostPlus = egg("Frost+ Egg", 3, 3000000, {"SnowOwl", "Walrus", "PolarBear", "IceGolem", "FrostTitan", "BlizzardDragon"}),
	Inferno = egg("Inferno Egg", 4, 30000000, {"MagmaSlime", "FireBat", "LavaHound", "FlameGolem", "Hellhound", "ThreeHeadedDragon"}),
	InfernoPlus = egg("Inferno+ Egg", 4, 250000000, {"EmberFox", "ObsidianTurtle", "PhoenixChick", "MagmaTitan", "InfernoDemon", "DemonKing"}),
	Galaxy = egg("Galaxy Egg", 5, 2500000000, {"Alien", "UFOCat", "StarWolf", "NebulaDragon", "VoidTitan", "CosmicGod"}),
	GalaxyPlus = egg("Galaxy+ Egg", 5, 20000000000, {"MoonBunny", "AstroDog", "MeteorGolem", "BlackHoleBeast", "GalaxyLeviathan", "InfinityDragon"}),
	-- Robux egg: bought with the MegaEgg dev product, odds shown before buying
	Mega = {Name = "Mega Egg", World = 1, Cost = 0, ProductKey = "MegaEgg", Pets = {
		{Id = "DiamondDog", Chance = 70},
		{Id = "RainbowDragon", Chance = 25},
		{Id = "GoldenCerberus", Chance = 5},
	}},
}

-- Lucky (pass or boost) doubles Epic and better, taken evenly from the rest
function Eggs.Roll(eggId, lucky, rng)
	local e = Eggs.List[eggId]
	local weights = {}
	local total = 0
	for i, entry in e.Pets do
		local w = entry.Chance
		if lucky and i >= 4 and #e.Pets == 6 then
			w *= 2
		end
		weights[i] = w
		total += w
	end
	local roll = rng:NextNumber() * total
	for i, entry in e.Pets do
		roll -= weights[i]
		if roll <= 0 then
			return entry.Id
		end
	end
	return e.Pets[1].Id
end

return Eggs

-- Builds the HUD in code (UiStyle buttons) and keeps it in sync with player
-- attributes. Visual only: every stat, unlock and purchase is decided on the server.
-- Passive Strength arrives once a second but is shown as +gain popups every 0.1s
-- with a smooth counter, so it feels like it never stops going up.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = Shared:WaitForChild("Config")
local Format = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Util"):WaitForChild("Format"))
local Purchase = require(Shared.Util:WaitForChild("Purchase"))
local Zones = require(Config:WaitForChild("Zones"))
local RebirthConfig = require(Config:WaitForChild("Rebirth"))
local Monetization = require(Config:WaitForChild("Monetization"))
local StatsConfig = require(Config:WaitForChild("Stats"))
local Gym = require(Config:WaitForChild("Gym"))
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local UiStyle = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("UiStyle"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local HudController = {}

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
local CLICK_LIMIT = 12

local ui = {}
local clickTimes = {}
local shownStrength = 0
local lastLevel = nil

local function make(className, props, children)
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for k, v in props do
		inst[k] = v
	end
	for _, child in children or {} do
		child.Parent = inst
	end
	return inst
end

local function corner(radius)
	return make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 12)})
end

local function label(props)
	local l = make("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Font = FONT,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	}, {make("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.5, Color = DARK})})
	for k, v in props do
		l[k] = v
	end
	return l
end

local ICONS = {
	Rebirth = "\u{1F504}",
	Pets = "\u{1F43E}",
	Shop = "\u{1F6D2}",
	Double = "\u{26A1}",
	AutoTrain = "\u{1F916}",
	AutoPunch = "\u{1F44A}",
	DoubleCoins = "\u{1FA99}",
	VIP = "\u{1F451}",
	Boost = "\u{1F680}",
	Train = "\u{1F4AA}",
}

local function button(name, text, color, size, parent, rainbow)
	local square = size.X.Offset > 0 and size.X.Offset == size.Y.Offset
	return UiStyle.Button({
		Name = name,
		Text = text,
		Color = color,
		Size = size,
		Shape = if square then "Square" else "Wide",
		Icon = ICONS[name],
		Rainbow = rainbow == true,
		Parent = parent,
	})
end

local function scaled(frame)
	local scale = make("UIScale", {Parent = frame})
	local function update()
		local size = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min(size.X / 1100, size.Y / 700), 0.55, 1)
	end
	update()
	workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update)
end

local function attr(name, default)
	local value = player:GetAttribute(name)
	if value == nil then
		return default
	end
	return value
end

local function optionalController(name)
	local module = script.Parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not module then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
	return if ok then result else nil
end

-- toasts and popups
local function notify(text)
	local toast = label({
		Text = text,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(620, 40),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 118),
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 120),
		Parent = ui.Gui,
	})
	TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 128)}):Play()
	task.delay(2.5, function()
		TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.4)
		toast:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function popup(text, color, big)
	local size = if big then UDim2.fromOffset(240, 46) else UDim2.fromOffset(140, 30)
	local p = label({
		Text = text,
		Size = size,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0, 0.42 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.18, 0),
		TextColor3 = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Rotation = (math.random() - 0.5) * 16,
		Parent = ui.Gui,
	})
	local goal = {Position = p.Position - UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.07), TextTransparency = 1}
	TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), goal):Play()
	task.delay(0.7, function()
		p:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function buyPass(passKey)
	local ok, reason = Purchase.Pass(passKey)
	if not ok and reason then
		notify(reason)
	end
end

local function buyProduct(productKey)
	local ok, reason = Purchase.Product(productKey)
	if not ok and reason then
		notify(reason)
	end
end

-- owned auto pass = toggle it, not owned = buy it
local function autoButton(passKey, field, remote)
	return function()
		if attr("Pass_" .. passKey, false) then
			remote:FireServer(not attr(field, true))
		else
			buyPass(passKey)
		end
	end
end

local function train()
	local now = os.clock()
	while clickTimes[1] and now - clickTimes[1] > 1 do
		table.remove(clickTimes, 1)
	end
	if #clickTimes >= CLICK_LIMIT then
		return
	end
	table.insert(clickTimes, now)
	Remotes.Train:FireServer()
	popup("+" .. Format.Number(attr("Gain", 1) * StatsConfig.ClickValue) .. " \u{1F4AA}", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90), true)
end

local function buildRebirthPanel()

	ui.BestText = label({Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 48), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 150), Parent = wallet})

		make("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 12), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}),

local function multLine(name, value, color)
	return string.format("<font color=\"%s\">%s %s</font>", color, Format.Multiplier(value), name)
end

local function timeLeft(field)
	return attr(field, 0) - os.time()
end

local function refresh()
	local level = attr("Level", 1)
	local rebirths = attr("Rebirths", 0)
	local gain = attr("Gain", 1)
	local worldIndex = attr("Zone", 1)
	local allowed = attr("AllowedZone", 1)
	local gymTier = attr("GymTier", 0)
	local xp = attr("XP", 0)
	local xpNeeded = math.max(attr("XPNeeded", 1), 1)

	if lastLevel and level > lastLevel then
		popup("LEVEL UP!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 140), true)
	end
	lastLevel = level

	ui.LevelText.Text = "Level " .. level
	ui.XpText.Text = Format.Number(xp) .. " / " .. Format.Number(xpNeeded)
	TweenService:Create(ui.LevelFill, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(xp / xpNeeded, 0, 1), 1)}):Play()
	ui.MultText.Text = table.concat({
		multLine("World", attr("Mult_World", 1), "#9BFF8A"),
		multLine("Gym", attr("Mult_Gym", 1), "#FF9B5A"),
		multLine("Rebirth", attr("Mult_Rebirth", 1), "#7FD4FF"),
		multLine("Pass", attr("Mult_Gamepass", 1), "#FFD84A"),
		multLine("Pets", attr("Mult_Pets", 1), "#FF9BD2"),
		multLine("Boost", attr("Mult_Boost", 1), "#D59BFF"),
	}, "  ")
	ui.CoinsText.Text = "\u{1FA99} " .. Format.Number(attr("Coins", 0)) .. " Coins"
	ui.BestText.Text = "\u{1F44A} Best: " .. Format.Number(attr("BestPunch", 0)) .. " ft"

	for i, dot in ui.WorldDots do
		dot.BackgroundTransparency = if i <= allowed then 0 else 0.6
		dot.Size = if i == worldIndex then UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52) else UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42)
	end
	local world = Zones.List[worldIndex]
	local nextWorld = Zones.List[allowed + 1]
	local text = world.Name .. " World \u{2022} x" .. world.Multiplier
	if gymTier > 0 then
		text ..= " \u{2022} " .. Gym.Tiers[gymTier].Name .. " x" .. Gym.Tiers[gymTier].Multiplier
	end
	text ..= if nextWorld then "   Next: " .. nextWorld.Name .. " at " .. Format.Number(nextWorld.Required) else "   All worlds open!"
	ui.WorldText.Text = text

	local need = RebirthConfig.LevelRequired(rebirths)
	ui.RebirthBadge.Visible = level >= need
	ui.RebirthFrom.Text = Format.Multiplier(RebirthConfig.Multiplier(rebirths))
	ui.RebirthTo.Text = Format.Multiplier(RebirthConfig.Multiplier(rebirths + 1))
	ui.RebirthNeed.Text = "Rebirth " .. (rebirths + 1) .. " needs Level " .. need
	ui.RebirthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(level / need, 0, 1), 1)
	ui.RebirthBarText.Text = math.min(level, need) .. " / " .. need
	ui.SkipButton.Label.Text = "Skip " .. Purchase.PriceText("Product", "RebirthSkip")

	for productKey, b in ui.PackButtons do
		b.Label.Text = "+" .. Format.Number(gain * Monetization.Products[productKey].Clicks)
	end

	ui.DoublePrice.Text = if attr("Pass_Double", false) then "OWNED" else "ONLY " .. Purchase.PriceText("Pass", "Double")
	ui.AutoClick.Label.Text = if attr("Pass_AutoTrain", false) then (if attr("AutoTrainOn", true) then "Auto Click: ON" else "Auto Click: OFF") else "Auto Click"
	ui.AutoPunch.Label.Text = if attr("Pass_AutoPunch", false) then (if attr("AutoPunchOn", true) then "Auto Punch: ON" else "Auto Punch: OFF") else "Auto Punch"
	local boostLeft = timeLeft("BoostEnd")
	ui.BoostButton.Label.Text = if boostLeft > 0 then string.format("x2 Boost %d:%02d", boostLeft // 60, boostLeft % 60) else "x2 Boost 15m"
end

local function passivePerSecond()
	local clicks = StatsConfig.PassiveClicks
	if attr("Pass_AutoTrain", false) and attr("AutoTrainOn", true) then
		clicks += StatsConfig.AutoClicks
	end
	return attr("Gain", 1) * clicks
end

function HudController.Start()
	buildHud()
	shownStrength = attr("Strength", 0)
	player.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(name)
		if name ~= "Strength" then
			refresh()
		end
	end)
	refresh()
	Remotes.Notify.OnClientEvent:Connect(notify)

	-- smooth counter: always creeping toward the real (server) value
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		local target = attr("Strength", 0)
		if target < shownStrength then
			shownStrength = target
		else
			shownStrength += (target - shownStrength) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
		end
		ui.StrengthText.Text = "\u{1F4AA} " .. Format.Number(shownStrength) .. " Strength   +" .. Format.Number(passivePerSecond()) .. "/sec"
	end)

	-- the illusion: a +gain popup every 0.1s
	task.spawn(function()
		local step = 1 / StatsConfig.PassiveClicks
		while true do
			task.wait(step)
			local character = player.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if attr("Loaded", false) and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				popup("+" .. Format.Number(passivePerSecond() * step), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), false)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- click or tap anywhere in the world to train
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			train()
		end
	end)

	-- live boost timer
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			if timeLeft("BoostEnd") > -2 then
				refresh()
			end
		end
	end)
end

return HudController

-- One saved profile per player. Never overwrites data after a failed load.
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DataService = {}

local STORE_NAME = "StatSim_v1"
local AUTOSAVE_SECONDS = 120
local MAX_RECEIPTS = 50

local store = nil
local profiles = {}
local canSave = {}
local loadedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
DataService.ProfileLoaded = loadedEvent.Event

local function defaults()
	return {
		Strength = 0,
		TotalStrength = 0,
		XP = 0,
		Level = 1,
		Rebirths = 0,
		BoostEnd = 0,
		AutoTrainOn = true,
		Coins = 0,
		BestPunch = 0,
		PetInv = {},
		NextPetUid = 1,
		CoinBoostEnd = 0,
		LuckEnd = 0,
		AutoPunchOn = true,
		AutoHatchOn = true,
		WorldUnlocked = 1,
		Receipts = {},
		ReceiptOrder = {},
	}
end

local function reconcile(data)
	for key, value in defaults() do
		if data[key] == nil then
			data[key] = value
		end
	end
	return data
end

local function withRetries(fn)
	local attempts = if RunService:IsStudio() then 1 else 3
	local lastErr = nil
	for attempt = 1, attempts do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		lastErr = result
		if attempt < attempts then
			task.wait(2 ^ (attempt - 1))
		end
	end
	return false, lastErr
end

local function key(player)
	return "player_" .. player.UserId
end

function DataService.Load(player)
	local ok, data = false, nil
	if store then
		ok, data = withRetries(function()
			return store:GetAsync(key(player))
		end)
	end
	if not player.Parent then
		return
	end
	if ok then
		profiles[player] = reconcile(data or defaults())
		canSave[player] = true
	elseif RunService:IsStudio() then
		warn("[DataService] DataStore not available in Studio. Using temp data, nothing saves. Turn on Game Settings > Security > Studio API access to test saving.")
		profiles[player] = defaults()
		canSave[player] = false
	else
		warn("[DataService] Load failed for " .. player.UserId .. ": " .. tostring(data))
		player:Kick("Could not load your data. Please rejoin.")
		return
	end
	loadedEvent:Fire(player, profiles[player])
end

-- Returns true when the profile is safely stored (or saving is off in Studio)
function DataService.Save(player)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile then
		return false
	end
	if not canSave[player] then
		return true
	end
	local ok, err = withRetries(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(key(player), function()
			return profile
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[DataService] Save failed for " .. player.UserId .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end
	return ok
end

function DataService.Get(player)
	return profiles[player]
end

function DataService.HasReceipt(profile, purchaseId)
	return profile.Receipts[purchaseId] == true
end

function DataService.AddReceipt(profile, purchaseId)
	profile.Receipts[purchaseId] = true
	table.insert(profile.ReceiptOrder, purchaseId)
	while #profile.ReceiptOrder > MAX_RECEIPTS do
		local old = table.remove(profile.ReceiptOrder, 1)
		profile.Receipts[old] = nil
	end
end

function DataService.Start()
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME)
	end)
	if ok then
		store = result
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(DataService.Load)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(DataService.Load, player)
	end

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		DataService.Save(player)
		profiles[player] = nil
		canSave[player] = nil
	end)

	game:BindToClose(function()
		local pending = 0
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				DataService.Save(player)
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		while pending > 0 do
			task.wait()
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				task.spawn(DataService.Save, player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return DataService

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local RebirthConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Rebirth)

local RebirthService = {}

-- reset = false is the paid Rebirth Skip (keeps Strength and level)
function RebirthService.DoRebirth(player, reset)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return false
	end
	profile.Rebirths += 1
	if reset then
		profile.Strength = 0
		profile.XP = 0
		profile.Level = 1
	end
	StatService.Refresh(player)
	Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Rebirth " .. profile.Rebirths .. "! Gains are now x" .. RebirthConfig.Multiplier(profile.Rebirths))
	return true
end

local function onRebirth(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	local need = RebirthConfig.LevelRequired(profile.Rebirths)
	if profile.Level < need then
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Reach Level " .. need .. " to rebirth")
		return
	end
	RebirthService.DoRebirth(player, true)
end

function RebirthService.Start()
	Remotes.Rebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(onRebirth)
end

return RebirthService

-- Gamepass ownership + the ONE ProcessReceipt for the whole game.
-- Grants happen only here, on the server. The client only opens Roblox prompts.
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config
local Monetization = require(Config.Monetization)
local Zones = require(Config.Zones)
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local StatService = require(script.Parent.StatService)
local RebirthService = require(script.Parent.RebirthService)
local PunchService = require(script.Parent.PunchService)
local EggService = require(script.Parent.EggService)

local MonetizationService = {}

local function grantStrength(player, product)
	StatService.AddStrength(player, StatService.Gain(player) * product.Clicks)
end

local function grantCoins(player, product)
	StatService.AddCoins(player, math.max(PunchService.CoinsPerPunch(player), 10) * product.Punches)
end

local function timed(field)
	return function(player, product)
		local profile = DataService.Get(player)
		profile[field] = math.max(profile[field], os.time()) + product.Seconds
		StatService.Refresh(player)
	end
end

local grants = {
	StrengthSmall = grantStrength,
	StrengthMedium = grantStrength,
	StrengthLarge = grantStrength,
	CoinsSmall = grantCoins,
	CoinsMedium = grantCoins,
	CoinsLarge = grantCoins,
	Boost = timed("BoostEnd"),
	CoinBoost = timed("CoinBoostEnd"),
	LuckBoost = timed("LuckEnd"),
	Level = function(player)
		StatService.AddLevels(player, 1)
	end,
	RebirthSkip = function(player)
		RebirthService.DoRebirth(player, false)
	end,
	WorldSkip = function(player)
		local profile = DataService.Get(player)
		profile.WorldUnlocked = math.min(StatService.AllowedWorld(profile) + 1, #Zones.List)
		StatService.Refresh(player)
	end,
	MegaEgg = function(player)
		EggService.Hatch(player, "Mega", 1, false, true)
	end,
}

local function processReceipt(info)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(info.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	-- Already granted earlier: only confirm once it is saved
	if DataService.HasReceipt(profile, info.PurchaseId) then
		if DataService.Save(player) then
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local productKey, product = Monetization.FindProduct(info.ProductId)
	if not productKey or not grants[productKey] then
		warn("[Monetization] Unknown product " .. tostring(info.ProductId))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local ok, err = pcall(grants[productKey], player, product)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Monetization] Grant failed: " .. tostring(err))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	DataService.AddReceipt(profile, info.PurchaseId)
	Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Thanks! " .. product.Name .. " received")

	if DataService.Save(player) then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
end

local function checkPasses(player)
	for passKey, pass in Monetization.Passes do
		if pass.Id ~= 0 then
			local ok, owns = pcall(MarketplaceService.UserOwnsGamePassAsync, MarketplaceService, player.UserId, pass.Id)
			if ok and owns then
				StatService.SetPass(player, passKey, true)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Studio only: buttons whose Id is still 0 grant for free so we can test them.
-- Live servers ignore this remote completely.
local function onStudioPurchase(player, kind, itemKey)
	if not RunService:IsStudio() then
		return
	end
	if typeof(kind) ~= "string" or typeof(itemKey) ~= "string" or not DataService.Get(player) then
		return
	end
	if kind == "Pass" then
		local pass = Monetization.Passes[itemKey]
		if pass and pass.Id == 0 then
			StatService.SetPass(player, itemKey, true)
			Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "[Studio test] " .. pass.Name .. " unlocked")
		end
	elseif kind == "Product" then
		local product = Monetization.Products[itemKey]
		if product and product.Id == 0 and grants[itemKey] then
			grants[itemKey](player, product)
			Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "[Studio test] " .. product.Name .. " received")
		end
	end
end

function MonetizationService.Start()
	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = processReceipt
	Remotes.StudioPurchase.OnServerEvent:Connect(onStudioPurchase)
	DataService.ProfileLoaded:Connect(checkPasses)

	-- Fired by Roblox on the server, so the client cannot fake it
	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
		if not purchased or passId == 0 then
			return
		end
		for passKey, pass in Monetization.Passes do
			if pass.Id == passId then
				StatService.SetPass(player, passKey, true)
				Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Thanks! " .. pass.Name .. " unlocked")
			end
		end
	end)
end

return MonetizationService

Random.new() local lastHatch = {} local stands = {} local function power(id) local p = PetsConfig.List[id] return if p then p.Power else 0 end -- Equip the strongest pets up to the slot limit function EggService.EquipBest(player) local profile = DataService.Get(player) if not profile then return end local sorted = table.clone(profile.PetInv) table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return power(a.p) > power(b.p) end) local slots = StatService.PetSlots(player) for _, entry in profile.PetInv do entry.e = false end for i = 1, math.min(slots, #sorted) do sorted[i].e = true end StatService.Refresh(player) end local function onEquip(player, uid, equip) local profile = DataService.Get(player) if not profile or typeof(uid) ~= "string" or typeof(equip) ~= "boolean" then return end local target = nil local equipped = 0 for _, entry in profile.PetInv do if entry.u == uid then target = entry end if entry.e then equipped += 1 end end if not target or target.e == equip then return end if equip and equipped >= StatService.PetSlots(player) then Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "All pet slots full! Unequip one or get +3 Pet Slots") return end target.e = equip StatService.Refresh(player) end -- free = true for the paid Mega Egg (already paid in Robux) function EggService.Hatch(player, eggId, count, isAuto, free) local profile = DataService.Get(player) local egg = Eggs.List[eggId] if not profile or not egg then return false end if egg.World > StatService.AllowedWorld(profile) then Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Unlock " .. Zones.List[egg.World].Name .. " World first") return false end if #profile.PetInv + count > PetsConfig.MaxInventory then Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Pet inventory full (" .. PetsConfig.MaxInventory .. ")") return false end if not free then local cost = egg.Cost * count if profile.Coins < cost then if not isAuto then Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Need " .. Format.Number(cost) .. " Coins. Punch the dummy!") end return false end profile.Coins -= cost end local lucky = StatService.IsLucky(player) local hatched = {} for _ = 1, count do local id = Eggs.Roll(eggId, lucky, rng) table.insert(profile.PetInv, {u = tostring(profile.NextPetUid), p = id, e = false}) profile.NextPetUid += 1 table.insert(hatched, id) end EggService.EquipBest(player) Remotes.HatchFx:FireClient(player, eggId, hatched, isAuto) for _, id in hatched do local rarity = PetsConfig.List[id].Rarity if rarity == "Legendary" or rarity == "Mythic" then for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do Remotes.Notify:FireClient(other, player.DisplayName .. " hatched a " .. string.upper(rarity) .. " " .. PetsConfig.List[id].Name .. "!") end end end return true end local function tryHatch(player, eggId, count) local now = os.clock() if lastHatch[player] and now - lastHatch[player] < HATCH_COOLDOWN then return end lastHatch[player] = now if count > 1 and not StatService.OwnsPass(player, "TripleHatch") then local pass = Monetization.Passes.TripleHatch if pass.Id ~= 0 then MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, pass.Id) elseif RunService:IsStudio() then Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Triple Hatch is a pass (free in Studio from the shop)") else Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Triple Hatch is coming soon") end return end EggService.Hatch(player, eggId, count, false, false) end local function promptMega(player) local product = Monetization.Products.MegaEgg if product.Id == 0 then if RunService:IsStudio() then EggService.Hatch(player, "Mega", 1, false, true) else Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Mega Egg is coming soon") end return end MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, product.Id) end -- Cosmetic factory only: hatching, currency, pass checks and odds are unchanged. local function eggModel(eggId) return require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.EggVisual).Make(eggId) end local function oddsBoard(stand, eggId) local egg = Eggs.List[eggId] local lines = {} for _, entry in egg.Pets do local pet = PetsConfig.List[entry.Id] local color = PetsConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity].Color table.insert(lines, string.format("%s %s%%", color:ToHex(), pet.Name, tostring(entry.Chance))) end local price = if egg.ProductKey then "ROBUX EGG" else Format.Number(egg.Cost) .. " Coins" local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui") bb.Name = "Odds" bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 200) bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 12, 0) bb.MaxDistance = 90 bb.LightInfluence = 0 local t = Instance.new("TextLabel") t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) t.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 40) t.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne t.TextScaled = true t.RichText = true t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) t.Text = string.format("%s\n%s\n%s", string.upper(egg.Name), price, table.concat(lines, "\n")) local corner = Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) corner.Parent = t local s = Instance.new("UIStroke") s.Thickness = 2 s.Parent = t t.Parent = bb bb.Parent = stand end local function prompt(stand, name, action, key, hold) local p = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt") p.Name = name p.ActionText = action p.ObjectText = "" p.HoldDuration = hold p.KeyboardKeyCode = key p.MaxActivationDistance = 14 p.RequiresLineOfSight = false p.Parent = stand return p end local function setupStand(stand) local eggId = stand:GetAttribute("EggId") local egg = eggId and Eggs.List[eggId] if not egg then return end stands[stand] = eggId local color = if egg.ProductKey then Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40) else Zones.List[egg.World].Color for _, child in stand:GetChildren() do if child.Name == "EggPreview" or child.Name == "Egg" then child:Destroy() end end local model = eggModel(eggId) model:PivotTo(stand.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, stand.Size.Y / 2 + 3.4, 0)) model.Parent = stand game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(model, "RemodeledEgg") oddsBoard(stand, eggId) if egg.ProductKey then prompt(stand, "BuyPrompt", "Buy Mega Egg", Enum.KeyCode.E, 0).Triggered:Connect(promptMega) else prompt(stand, "HatchPrompt", "Hatch (" .. Format.Number(egg.Cost) .. ")", Enum.KeyCode.E, 0.2).Triggered:Connect(function(player) tryHatch(player, eggId, 1) end) prompt(stand, "Hatch3Prompt", "Hatch x3", Enum.KeyCode.R, 0.2).Triggered:Connect(function(player) tryHatch(player, eggId, 3) end) end end local function nearestStand(player) local character = player.Character local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if not root then return nil end local best, bestDist = nil, AUTO_RANGE for stand, eggId in stands do if not Eggs.List[eggId].ProductKey then local d = (stand.Position - root.Position).Magnitude if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = eggId, d end end end return best end function EggService.Start() for _, stand in workspace:WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("Gameplay"):GetDescendants() do if stand:IsA("BasePart") and stand:GetAttribute("EggId") then setupStand(stand) end end Remotes.EquipPet.OnServerEvent:Connect(onEquip) Remotes.EquipBest.OnServerEvent:Connect(EggService.EquipBest) Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) lastHatch[player] = nil end) -- Auto Hatch pass: hatches the closest egg while you stand near it task.spawn(function() while true do task.wait(AUTO_INTERVAL) for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do local profile = DataService.Get(player) if profile and profile.AutoHatchOn and StatService.OwnsPass(player, "AutoHatch") then local eggId = nearestStand(player) if eggId then local count = if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "TripleHatch") then 3 else 1 EggService.Hatch(player, eggId, count, true, false) end end end end end) end return EggService
